name: Hit List
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Jeitinho, Rebellion Without Rehearsal's Criminal weapon, which the Runner adds to their score area as an assassination agenda after a turn of successful runs on HQ, R&D and Archives, and wins with the third. On Gabriel Santiago, the one Criminal identity no deck plays, whose HQ credits pay for the turn's first run, and on Borrowed Time's frame after Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 8b, with three Jeitinho for a Tailgate, a VRcation and a Pennyshaver. Eternal-legal only: Gabriel Santiago is a Core Set card. The Automata Initiative Stage 2: two Shibboleth for two VRcation. The Automata Initiative Stage 3: two Curupira for two Marjanah, fracter for fracter, and two Laser Pointer for two Leech. The Automata Initiative Stage 4: Hermes for the T400 Memory Diamond, memory for memory, and two Saci for two Rotary. Parhelion Stage 4b: two WAKE Implant v2A-JRJ for two Docklands Pass, two Poison Vial for two Pennyshaver and two Tremolo for two Buzzsaw, all six of which Borrowed Time still carries. Parhelion Stage 5d: two Concerto for its two Tailgate, a run paid for by the top of the stack; two Reprise for its two Sell Out, a steal's follow-up; and two Asmund Pudlat for its two Verbal Plasticity, which finds its weapons — Jeitinho, Poison Vial, Laser Pointer — and its Conduit. Parhelion Stage 6b: two Tunnel Vision for two of its three Smartware Distributor, and two Info Bounty for two of its three Red Team, job for job, so the turn begins by identifying a mark that Tunnel Vision breaks on and Info Bounty pays for. Parhelion Stage 7: four Matryoshka for its two Carmen, one installed hosting the others, a click each, and each break of X subroutines turning one copy facedown until the Runner's turn; the two Smartware Distributor Stage 7 was first written to take had already gone to Tunnel Vision in Stage 6b, so the deck is two cards over its 46, at 48. Midnight Sun Stage 2: two Revolver, a killer, for its two Word on the Street; two PAN-Weave for its two Borrowed Goods, an HQ run paying a credit beside Gabriel's; and two No Free Lunch for its two Mutual Favor. Borrowed Time still carries all three. Midnight Sun Stage 3: two Cezve for two of its three Kompromat, recurring credits that pay during runs on the central servers Jeitinho needs; Borrowed Time still carries Kompromat. Phase 5 §33: two Malandragem, in faction here, since Grassroots' one copy (four influence there) was reached in two of 768 view-sweep games — trashed both times, installed by no seat — and in none once the planner's samples carried the identities. Midnight Sun Stage 5: two Cat's Cradle for its Conduit and its Smartware Distributor, a decoder that taxes every code gate's rez, so Asmund Pudlat finds only its weapons now; Borrowed Time and Mixtape keep both. Uprising Stage 2: two Penumbral Toolkit for two of its three Underdome Irregulars, 4[credit] to spend during runs, 2[credit] cheaper after a successful run on HQ, which Gabriel makes every turn. Uprising Stage 3: two Bravado for its two Info Bounty, a run on a server with ice that pays 6[credit] and one per ice passed; a Swift for its Red Team, the console that gives a click for the first run event each turn; The Back and a Prognostic Q-Loop for its two Tunnel Vision, a counter for a hardware use during a run, and a look and an install off the top of the stack. Other decks keep every card given up here.
